description: issue #427 negative case (M4 audit): without the `geometry` profile active, `grid` is not a registered primitive, so `define grid ... end` is an ordinary procedure declaration and raises no `ol-reserved-word` diagnostic — mirroring the `data`-gating discipline the Data branch (#405) already follows for `dict`/`keys`/etc. SCOPE, CORRECTED: maintainer ruling #833 (merged as #875) retracted that gate for the NAMING axis. `spec/grammar.md:408` makes the primitives of every optional profile built-in names unconditionally -- what a profile decides is whether a name WORKS, never whether a program may declare it -- so a conforming 0.4.0 implementation must raise `ol-reserved-word` on this `define grid` with or without the profile. This fixture therefore pins SHIPPED BEHAVIOUR the spec now contradicts, and is kept red-flagged rather than deleted so the behaviour is not silently unpinned; issue #841 lands the always-on built-in-names list and flips this expectation.
